messages:
maya: Heads-up — a customer reported being billed for ~120 tokens after a stream disconnect, but the client only acked 32. Curious where the extra tokens are coming from. Anyone seen this pattern before?
charlie: I saw a few similar logs last week. Quick dump:
```
[stream:start] req_id=ra-9f reserved_tokens=128
[stream:emit] req_id=ra-9f acked_tokens=32 sent_tokens=120
[stream:close] req_id=ra-9f reason=client_disconnect
billing: apply_reserved_tokens -> charged=128 (bug?)
```
charlie: Looks like we might be charging the reserved/burst tokens on close rather than actual acked count.
sophia: That fits with the reservation model we added for burst QoS — we reserve tokens at start to avoid mid-stream stalls. I thought we only charged what was consumed though.
leah: Policy options we discussed earlier: 1) bill only acked tokens (safe, but servers may lose money if we give big reservation and client never sends), 2) bill reservation on start (current), 3) hybrid: hold reservation for a short grace window for reconnects then release.
dan: For streaming UX / API surface we could add an explicit finalization signal from clients (e.g., stream_end/final_ack) so server knows when client really finished. Also add server->client heartbeat that includes ack offset.
maya: Client-side didn't send a final event; it just disconnected. Customer said they tried reconnect within 3s.
charlie: Edge-case: mobile clients can drop then reconnect and resume; if we release reservation immediately we might lose the slot and cause extra latency on reconnect.
leah: Proposed concrete: keep reservation semantics but change billing to: charge min(acked + buffer, reserved). Buffer = 16 tokens or 10% of reserved (configurable per-org). Release reservation after 5s of no reconnect.
sophia: I like buffer approach for UX. Also we should surface exact numbers in the Console (per-request stream metrics): streaming.acked_tokens, streaming.reserved_tokens, streaming.released_tokens -> let CS debug billing disputes.
dan: Telemetry change is straightforward: add new metrics tags on the stream lifecycle events. Backend needs to emit streaming.ack_delta on each ACK. Console needs a small table in request history showing ack vs charged.
charlie: Compatibility: some SDKs won't send ACK frames right away. We need a fallback: if no ack frames seen and stream closed, fall back to sent_tokens estimation from server-side emission logs.
infra-bot: rollout suggestion: feature-flag the new billing behavior per-org, default to old behavior for existing customers. Gradually flip for new customers and dedicated clusters first.
maya: Ops question — how do we avoid large retrospective bills while we iterate? We should not retroactively charge or refund until we're sure.
leah: Agreed. Implement monitoring alert for discrepancies >200 tokens for single request and a daily aggregate to flag regressions.
dan: API detail: add header X-Stream-Finalized: true on the last chunk (SDKs add automatically). Also emit event stream.final_ack with final_token_count. Docs + SDK changelog required.
charlie: Implementation plan:
- short term (1wk): telemetry + alerting, conservative billing switch (don't charge reservation if acked < reserved and reconnect within 5s) behind flag
- mid term (3w): API finalization header + SDK updates, console UI for stream metrics
- long term (8w): per-org config for buffer size and default policy, rollout to hosted clusters
maya: Can someone pick tech lead for the short-term work? Charlie?
charlie: I can own short-term. I'll open a PR for telemetry changes and add a feature flag.
sophia: I'll draft the Console wire (small table in request pane) and add the billing explainer to docs.
leah: I'll write the policy doc for finance + CS and create the alert rule.
infra-bot: @oncall this will touch billing infra — expect a migration job to re-evaluate outstanding reservations. Schedule a maintenance window if needed.
maya: Great. For the customer in question, let's refund difference proactively and explain we're rolling out a fix. :white_check_mark:
charlie: I'll do the refund ticket now and link to the PR when ready.
maya: Thanks all. Follow-ups in #eng-platform; marking as triaged. :thumbsup:
